title: Another star thrown out by a supernova
statement: Exhibit a Gaia DR3 star, not already reported as a supernova runaway (params.known), that is unbound from the Milky Way, moving outward, and launched from the disk rather than the Galactic centre: with its Gaia DR3 astrometry, a stated distance and a published radial velocity, at least 99.7% of error samples have Galactocentric speed above the escape speed of MWPotential2014 with the halo scaled by 1.5 and Galactocentric radial velocity above zero, and in at least 99.7% of back-integrated orbits over the last 150 Myr the path crossed the disk (|z| < 0.3 kpc, R < 30 kpc) and never came within 1 kpc of the Galactic centre.
witness_format: JSON object: source_id (Gaia DR3), ra_deg, dec_deg, pmra_mas_yr, pmra_error_mas_yr, pmdec_mas_yr, pmdec_error_mas_yr, rv_km_s, rv_error_km_s, rv_source, and either parallax_mas + parallax_error_mas (S/N >= 5) or distance_kpc + distance_error_kpc + distance_source

known.name: LP 40-365 (Vennes et al. 2017; Raddi et al. 2018)
